channel.description: A five to six minute daily audio digest of Supreme Court and High Court judgments, new laws, national news and editorials, for law students and judiciary aspirants in India.

item.title: Eklavya's Morning Brief, Thursday 12 November 2026
item.description: The Morning Brief for Thursday, 12 November 2026. In this edition: Prohibitory Orders Near SC Premises Not Lifted; Display Board Can Be Kept : Supreme Court Clarifies; October 2026: Pendency hits record high, soars past 96,000 - Supreme Court Observer; CBDT exempts dividends paid between IFSC aircraft-leasing units from TDS under Income-tax Act, 2025; Gauhati High Court Quashes Activist's NSA Detention Linked With Protest Against Luxury Hotel Project, Cites Multiple Procedural Lapses; Scientific Measurement, Digital Monitoring: Kerala High Court Appreciates Devaswom Board Efforts To Address Irregularity In Sabarimala Ghee Sales; Merely Producing Voter Lists With Ancestor's Names Does Not Establish Citizenship Without Proof Of Family Linkage: Gauhati High Court; and 28 more stories.
